ENFORCEMENT RULE OF THE ACT ON CARBON DIOXIDE CAPTURE, TRANSPORT, STORAGE AND UTILIZATION

Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on Carbon Dioxide Capture, Transport, Storage and Utilization and its Enforcement Decree and matters necessary for their enforcement.

Article 2 (Reports on Plans to Install and Operate Carbon Dioxide Capture Facilities) The report and change report under Article 8 (1) and (4) of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on Carbon Dioxide Capture, Transport, Storage and Utilization (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”) shall use the report on a plan to install and operate carbon dioxide capture facilities (or a change thereto) in attached Form 1.

Article 3 (Application for Approval of Carbon Dioxide Transportation Business) “Application for approval prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment” in Article 10 (2) of the Decree means the application for approval of carbon dioxide transportation business in attached Form 2. <Amended on October 1, 2025>

Article 4 (Matters to Be Included in Safety Management Rules) “Matters prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment” in Article 9 (1) 3 of the Act on Carbon Dioxide Capture, Transport, Storage and Utilization (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”) means the following matters: <Amended on October 1, 2025>
1. Duties and number of safety managers under Article 10 (1) of the Act;
2. Management of work on carbon dioxide transportation pipelines;
3. Education and training of personnel at the place of business.

Article 5 (Reporting Appointment of Safety Managers)
① “Period prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment” in Article 10 (1) of the Act means 15 days. <Amended on October 1, 2025>
② A pipeline installer and operator (meaning a person approved under the main clause of Article 8 (1) of the Act; hereinafter the same shall apply) intending to report appointment of a safety manager under Article 10 (1) of the Act shall submit to the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment a report on appointment of a safety manager for a carbon dioxide transportation pipeline in attached Form 3, accompanied by a copy of the appointed manager's national technical qualification certificate. <Amended on October 1, 2025>
③ “Period prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment” in Article 10 (2) of the Act means 30 days; provided that, if a pipeline installer and operator cannot appoint another safety manager within that period, the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment may approve an extension of up to 30 days. <Amended on October 1, 2025>

Article 6 (Application for Safety Inspection) “Application for safety inspection prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment” in Article 14 (1) of the Decree means the application for safety inspection of a carbon dioxide transportation pipeline in attached Form 4. <Amended on October 1, 2025>

Article 7 (Application to Extend Validity Period of Safety Inspection) “Application to extend the validity period of a safety inspection prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment” in Article 15 (2) of the Decree means the application to extend the validity period of a safety inspection of a carbon dioxide transportation pipeline in attached Form 5. <Amended on October 1, 2025>

Article 8 (Application for and Certificate of Exploration Approval)
① “Application for exploration approval prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment” in Article 16 (1) of the Decree means the application for approval of exploration for a storage site in attached Form 6. <Amended on October 1, 2025>
② “Certificate of exploration approval prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment” in Article 16 (5) of the Decree means the certificate of approval of exploration for a storage site in attached Form 7. <Amended on October 1, 2025>

Article 9 (Submission of Exploration Results)
① An exploration right holder under Article 18 (1) of the Decree shall submit a report on exploration results containing the following matters to the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment: <Amended on October 1, 2025>
1. The location and area explored;
2. The number and location of boreholes (only if drilling was conducted);
3. The location and storage capacity of candidate storage sites discovered;
4. Geological data concerning exploration and drilling.
② “Application to extend the period for submitting exploration results prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment” in Article 18 (3) of the Decree means the application to extend the period for submitting exploration results for a storage site in attached Form 8. <Amended on October 1, 2025>

Article 10 (Application for Approval of Completion of Restoration) “Application for approval prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment” in Article 25 (5) of the Decree means the application for approval of completion of restoration of a storage site in attached Form 9. <Amended on October 1, 2025>

Article 11 (Applications for Permission for Storage Business) The application for permission for storage business and the application for permission to change storage business under Article 26 (1) and (3) of the Decree shall use the application for permission or change permission for storage business in attached Form 10.

Article 12 (Report on Use of a Storage Site) “Report on use of a storage site prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment” in Article 28 of the Decree means the report on use of a storage site in attached Form 11. <Amended on October 1, 2025>

Article 13 (Reports on Succession to Status of Storage Business Operators)
① “Report on succession to status prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment” in Article 29 (1) of the Decree means the report on succession to the status of a storage business operator in attached Form 12. <Amended on October 1, 2025>
② If an heir of a storage business operator intends to succeed to that status under Article 20 (3) of the Act, the heir shall submit the report under paragraph ① to the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment, accompanied by documents proving heirship. Article 29 (2) of the Decree shall apply mutatis mutandis to shared use of administrative information in this case. <Amended on October 1, 2025>

Article 14 (Report on Commencement of Storage Business) “Report on commencement of storage business prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment” in Article 30 of the Decree means the report on commencement of storage business in attached Form 13. <Amended on October 1, 2025>

Article 15 (Application for Permission to Suspend or Close Storage Business) “Application for permission prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment” in the part other than the subparagraphs of Article 31 (1) of the Decree means the application for permission to suspend or close storage business in attached Form 14. <Amended on October 1, 2025>

Article 16 (Criteria for Administrative Dispositions against Storage Business Operators) The criteria for administrative dispositions for each violation under Article 23 (2) of the Act shall be as specified in attached Table 1.

Article 17 (Application for Approval of Monitoring Plan) “Application for approval prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment” in Article 33 (3) of the Decree means the application for approval of a monitoring plan for a storage site in attached Form 15. <Amended on October 1, 2025>

Article 18 (Application for Approval of Temporary Suspension of Storage Site Operations) “Application for approval of temporary suspension prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment” in Article 36 (5) of the Decree means the application for approval of temporary suspension of a storage site in attached Form 16. <Amended on October 1, 2025>

Article 19 (Application for Designation of Cluster) “Application for designation prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment” in Article 39 (2) of the Decree means the application for designation of a carbon dioxide capture, storage and utilization cluster in attached Form 17. <Amended on October 1, 2025>

Article 20 (Application for Revocation of Designation of Cluster) “Application for revocation of designation prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment” in the part other than the subparagraphs of Article 42 (2) of the Decree means the application for revocation of designation of a carbon dioxide capture, storage and utilization cluster in attached Form 18. <Amended on October 1, 2025>

Article 21 (Application for Designation of Specialized Personnel Training Institution) “Application for designation prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment” in the part other than the subparagraphs of Article 58 (2) of the Decree means the application for designation of an institution for training specialized personnel in attached Form 19. <Amended on October 1, 2025>

Article 22 (Application for Designation of Specialized Institution for Standardization Projects) “Application for designation prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment” in Article 59 (2) of the Decree means the application for designation of a specialized institution for standardization projects in attached Form 20. <Amended on October 1, 2025>

ADDENDA <Ordinance No. 597, February 6, 2025>

This Rule shall enter into force on February 7, 2025.

Criteria for Administrative Dispositions by Violation (Related to Article 16)

■ Enforcement Rule of the Act on Carbon Dioxide Capture, Transport, Storage and Utilization [Attached Table 1]

Criteria for Administrative Dispositions by Violation (Related to Article 16)

1. General criteria

  (a) If two or more violations are committed and their respective disposition criteria differ, the more severe criterion applies. If all applicable criteria prescribe suspension of business, the period under the more severe criterion may be increased by up to one half of that period, without exceeding the sum of the periods under all applicable criteria.

  (b) The criteria for administrative dispositions based on the number of violations apply if an administrative disposition was imposed for the same violation within the most recent year. The period is calculated from the date of the disposition for the earlier violation to the date on which a repetition of the same violation is detected after that disposition.

  (c) When an increased disposition is imposed under item (b), the applicable violation count shall be the count following that of the disposition imposed before the violation (or the higher count, if two or more dispositions were imposed within the period under item (b)).

  (d) The disposition authority may increase a disposition under the individual criteria in item 2 in either of the following cases. If the disposition is suspension of business, it may be increased by up to one half of its prescribed period but may not exceed six months:
    1) The violation was committed intentionally or through gross negligence;
    2) The content or severity of the violation is significant and is deemed to cause substantial harm to public safety.

  (e) The disposition authority may reduce a disposition under the individual criteria in item 2 in any of the following cases. A suspension of business may be reduced by up to one half of its prescribed period. Revocation of permission may be reduced to a six-month suspension of business, except in cases under Article 23 (1) 1 or 3 of the Act:
    1) The violation is deemed to have resulted from minor negligence or error;
    2) The violator has corrected or eliminated the consequences of the violation;
    3) A reduction is deemed necessary in light of the content, severity, motive or consequences of the violation.

2. Individual criteria

| Violation | Legal basis | First violation | Second violation | Third violation | Fourth violation |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1. Obtaining permission for storage business under the main clause of Article 18 (1) of the Act by false or other improper means | Article 23 (1) 1 of the Act | Revocation of permission | — | — | — |
| 2. Falling below the permission criteria under Article 18 (4) of the Act | Article 23 (1) 2 of the Act | Suspension of business for 1 month | Suspension for 3 months | Suspension for 6 months | Revocation of permission |
| 3. Becoming disqualified from permission for storage business under Article 19 of the Act (excluding where an heir falling under any of subparagraphs 1 through 4 of Article 19 transfers the business to another person within six months after the decedent's death, or where a corporation falling under subparagraph 5 of that Article replaces its representative within three months) | Article 23 (1) 3 of the Act | Revocation of permission | — | — | — |
| 4. Failing to obtain permission under the proviso of Article 22 (1) of the Act | Article 23 (1) 4 of the Act | Suspension of business for 1 month | Suspension for 3 months | Suspension for 6 months | Revocation of permission |
| 5. Violating an obligation concerning the condition of carbon dioxide to be stored under Article 27 of the Act | Article 23 (1) 5 of the Act | Suspension of business for 1 month | Suspension for 3 months | Suspension for 6 months | Revocation of permission |
